exam.title: CompTIA A+ Core 2 (V15)
exam.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite; CompTIA recommends about 12 months of hands-on IT support experience. Practice supported multi-OS selection/install/configuration, native Windows/Linux/macOS/mobile tools, identity and endpoint/SOHO/browser security, evidence-preserving malware response, controlled software troubleshooting, tickets/change/backup/recovery, safety/privacy/licensing, scripting review, and consent-based remote support. Pass 220-1201 and 220-1202 from the same V15 series.

review.notes: All four weighted V15 domains are mapped to controlled support, three scenarios, eight safe labs and 40 original checks. Same-version and non-dated estimated-2028 lifecycle boundaries are explicit. All eight URLs are cataloged: six reachable and O'Reilly plus Udemy automation-blocked; none missing or broken. No proprietary objective PDF, PBQs, course labs, or recalled questions are used.

findings.title: Summary coverage omitted cloud productivity and AI depth
findings.evidence: The full outline includes numbered cloud-productivity and AI objectives beyond the main-page summary.
findings.recommendation: Map all 36 numbered objectives and add original identity/license/sharing and AI-review cases, command/feature distinctions and 42 answers.
findings.resolution: Map all 36 numbered objectives and add original identity/license/sharing and AI-review cases, command/feature distinctions and 42 answers.

findings.title: Exam scope and OS lifecycle needed separation
findings.evidence: Windows 10 ordinary end of support coexists with specific ESU and LTSC conditions; Enterprise and IoT LTSC 2021 have different dates.
findings.recommendation: Explain the distinction and require exact edition/version/enrollment checks; do not infer deployment support from exam wording.
findings.resolution: Explain the distinction and require exact edition/version/enrollment checks; do not infer deployment support from exam wording.

findings.title: Edition labels alone cannot establish encryption protection
findings.evidence: Device Encryption can be available on eligible Home devices; recovery depends on configuration and the authorized recovery route.
findings.recommendation: Separate Home Device Encryption, full BitLocker, active protection and recovery; no keys read or configuration changes executed.
findings.resolution: Separate Home Device Encryption, full BitLocker, active protection and recovery; no keys read or configuration changes executed.

findings.title: Malware sequence and recovery boundaries needed precision
findings.evidence: PDF 2.6 explicitly includes Windows Home System Restore milestones; Microsoft describes system-state restoration separately from personal-file backup.
findings.recommendation: Teach the objective sequence alongside approved incident/evidence handling and retain independent backup/recovery checks.
findings.resolution: Teach the objective sequence alongside approved incident/evidence handling and retain independent backup/recovery checks.

findings.title: Recognizing disposal methods does not prove successful sanitization
findings.evidence: Revision 2 distinguishes clear/purge/destroy, media-specific limitations and verification versus validation; degaussing flash or partial physical damage does not prove erasure.
findings.recommendation: Explain SSD overwrite/CE key-copy limitations and require media-appropriate validation and records; no disposal performed.
findings.resolution: Explain SSD overwrite/CE key-copy limitations and require media-appropriate validation and records; no disposal performed.

findings.title: Copy/restore behavior needed an executed example
findings.evidence: Robocopy uses nonzero successful/difference return codes and flags with different deletion effects.
findings.recommendation: Add a synthetic native example and 18 actual checks for copy/repeat/restore, hashes, extras, list-only, failure and guarded cleanup; no mirror/purge used.
findings.resolution: Add a synthetic native example and 18 actual checks for copy/repeat/restore, hashes, extras, list-only, failure and guarded cleanup; no mirror/purge used.
